ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached image is a weighted undirected graph, with a total of 9 black-dot vertices. Marked by position as: top T, upper left U, upper right V, far left L, middle C, lower left P, lower right Q, far right R, bottom B. The edge weights read from the figure are: TU=9, TV=16, UV=11, LU=3, LP=19, UP=20, UC=4, VC=4, VQ=18, VR=11, RQ=17, PC=8, CQ=2, PQ=6, PB=3, QB=14. Reasoning: The problem asks to find the minimum total weight of a path that visits each vertex exactly once, namely the minimum Hamiltonian path. Use Held-Karp dynamic programming according to the specified method: let DP[S][j] denote the minimum path weight for visiting the vertex set S and ending at j, initialize DP[{j}][j]=0; if j is connected to an unvisited vertex k, then use DP[S][j]+w(j,k) to update DP[S∪{k}][k]. After processing all subsets for the above 9 vertices and the 16 edges in the graph, the minimum value on the set of all vertices is 65. A corresponding optimal path can be obtained by backtracking: T-U-L-P-B-Q-C-V-R, whose weight is 9+3+19+3+14+2+4+11=65. Therefore the minimum weight is 65.

raw_record.question_text: We define the $\emph{weight}$ of a path to be the sum of the numbers written on each edge of the path. Find the minimum weight among all paths in the graph that visit each vertex precisely once.

method.method_draft: First describe the graph from the image by labeling vertices by position: top T, upper-left U, upper-right V, leftmost L, center C, lower-left P, lower-right Q, rightmost R, bottom B. Read the edge weights from the image: TU=9, TV=16, UV=11, LU=3, LP=19, UP=20, UC=4, VC=4, VQ=18, VR=11, RQ=17, PC=8, CQ=2, PQ=6, PB=3, QB=14. From the text, interpret the task as finding the minimum-weight Hamiltonian path, i.e. a path visiting every one of the 9 vertices exactly once with total edge-sum minimized. Use Held-Karp dynamic programming for Hamiltonian paths: let DP[S][j] be the minimum weight of a path that visits exactly the vertex set S and ends at vertex j. Initialize DP[{j}][j]=0 for every vertex. For each state, extend along any image-read edge j-k to an unvisited vertex k, updating DP[S∪{k}][k] = min(DP[S∪{k}][k], DP[S][j]+w(j,k)). After all subsets are processed, take min_j DP[all vertices][j]. The backpointer check can exhibit an optimal path such as T-U-L-P-B-Q-C-V-R with total 9+3+19+3+14+2+4+11=65, and the DP minimum certifies no smaller Hamiltonian path exists.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：附图是一个带权无向图，共有9个黑点顶点。按位置标记为：顶部 T，左上 U，右上 V，最左 L，中间 C，左下 P，右下 Q，最右 R，底部 B。从图中读取到的边权为：TU=9，TV=16，UV=11，LU=3，LP=19，UP=20，UC=4，VC=4，VQ=18，VR=11，RQ=17，PC=8，CQ=2，PQ=6，PB=3，QB=14。推理：题目要求找访问每个顶点恰好一次的路径的最小总权重，即最小 Hamiltonian path。按指定方法使用 Held-Karp 动态规划：令 DP[S][j] 表示访问顶点集合 S 且以 j 结尾的最小路径权重，初始化 DP[{j}][j]=0；若 j 与未访问顶点 k 相连，则用 DP[S][j]+w(j,k) 更新 DP[S∪{k}][k]。对上述9个顶点和图中16条边处理所有子集后，所有顶点集合上的最小值为65。对应的一条最优路径可由回溯得到：T-U-L-P-B-Q-C-V-R，其权重为 9+3+19+3+14+2+4+11=65。因此最小权重为65。
